lines: भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन, अंतरिक्ष विभाग
Students will be provided opportunity for internships at organization in order to help them get exposure to practical side of learning.

MCF, one of the leading Centers of ISRO, provides opportunity for student's community to carry out Internship as well as project work as part of their academic curriculum. Internship opportunity is provided UG/PG/PhD student. The period of Internship will be for a minimum period of 15 days and maximum period of 45 days.
Following are the guidelines for pursuing Internship in MCF:
The candidate should be Citizen of India.
The candidate should be pursuing UG/PG/PhD from a recognized University/Institution (India/Abroad).
The candidate should have completed UG/PG from a recognized University/Institution, seeking internship opportunity within 6 months from the date of completion of Course.
The candidate should be a student enrolled for regular on-campus program in a recognized University/Institution .
The candidate should have completed UG/PG/PhD as a regular on campus student.
Students will be allotted internship work at MCF based on the availability of projects,
facilities and suitability of student's course to the work carried out at MCF.
The allotment of internship will be on first come first serve basis only and the availability of number of slots per year is limited.
Students studying in 5th Semester or 3rd Year onwards are eligible for applying. The interns will not be provided
any kind of financial assistance like stipends, transport and accommodation.
Normally, allotment of Internship will be in the month of August to October of
every year. On consideration, internship may be allowed in other months also based on
available resources due to Mission Critical Activities.
with permission letter from head of the institution at least 15 days in advance.
Opportunity will be provided for UG/PG/PhD students to carry out their final
year/semester project work as per the eligibility criteria mentioned below:
The student should have completed 1st semester
The students should have possessed aggregate of minimum 60% or CGPA 6.32 on a scale of 10.
Students will be allotted Project work at MCF based on the availability of projects & facilities and suitability of student’s course to the work carried out at MCF.
The allotment of project work will be on first come first serve basis only and the number of slots available are limited.
The students will not be provided any
kind of financial assistance like stipends and accommodation facilities
Interested students willing to apply for Project work have to send their resume, request letter from college and all
semester mark sheets either by post or by email to the following address:
Department of Space, Government of India
